description: Source code for embedding operations in PyTorch, including functions for embedding lookup, backward passes, and renormalization, utilizing tensor utilities and sparse tensor support.

methods.name: embedding_symint
methods.description: Performs embedding lookup with symbolic integer sizes, handling both 1D and multi-dimensional indices.

methods.name: embedding_backward_symint
methods.description: Performs backward pass for embedding, supporting sparse and dense gradients with symbolic sizes.

methods.name: embedding_sparse_backward
methods.description: Computes sparse gradient tensor for embedding layer, handling padding and index filtering.

methods.name: embedding_dense_backward_cpu
methods.description: Computes dense gradient tensor for embedding layer on CPU, with optional scaling by frequency.

methods.name: embedding_renorm_cpu_
methods.description: Renormalizes embedding vectors based on max norm constraint, for specified indices.
